sources.title: Lecture Notes on Differential Geometry
sources.why: 节点现有资源 MIT OCW 18.950 的 lecture-notes 页只公布 4 个章标题、没有逐讲题目，粒度不足；Ghomi（Georgia Tech）的讲义目录逐讲列出具体主题，第一卷曲线与曲面、第二卷流形，恰好覆盖节点的曲线曲面、流形、切空间、度量、联络与曲率六个知识点。

items.title: Definition of curves, examples, reparametrizations, length, Cauchy-Crofton formula, curves of constant width
items.zh: 曲线的定义与例子、重参数化、长度、Cauchy–Crofton 公式、定宽曲线

items.title: Isometries of Euclidean space, formulas for curvature of smooth regular curves
items.zh: 欧氏空间的等距变换、光滑正则曲线的曲率公式

items.title: General definition of curvature using polygonal approximations (Fox-Milnor's theorem)
items.zh: 用折线逼近给出曲率的一般定义（Fox–Milnor 定理）

items.title: Curves of constant curvature, the principal normal, signed curvature, turning angle
items.zh: 常曲率曲线、主法向量、带号曲率、转角

items.title: Osculating circle, Kneser's Nesting Theorem, total curvature, convex curves
items.zh: 密切圆、Kneser 嵌套定理、全曲率、凸曲线

items.title: The four vertex theorem, Shur's arm lemma, isoperimetric inequality
items.zh: 四顶点定理、Schur 臂引理、等周不等式

items.title: Torsion, Frenet-Seret frame, helices, spherical curves
items.zh: 挠率、Frenet–Serret 标架、螺旋线、球面曲线

items.title: Definition of surface, differential map
items.zh: 曲面的定义、微分映射

items.title: Gaussian curvature, Gauss map, shape operator, coefficients of the first and second fundamental forms, curvature of graphs
items.zh: 高斯曲率、Gauss 映射、形状算子、第一与第二基本形式的系数、函数图像的曲率

items.title: Interpretations of Gaussian curvature as a measure of local convexity, ratio of areas, and products of principal curvatures
items.zh: 高斯曲率的三种解释：局部凸性度量、面积比、主曲率之积

items.title: Intrinsic metric and isometries of surfaces, Gauss's Theorema Egregium, Brioschi's formula for Gaussian curvature
items.zh: 曲面的内蕴度量与等距、Gauss 绝妙定理、高斯曲率的 Brioschi 公式

items.title: Gauss's formulas, Christoffel symbols, Gauss and Codazzi-Mainardi equations, Riemann curvature tensor, and a second proof of Gauss's Theorema Egregium
items.zh: Gauss 公式、Christoffel 符号、Gauss 与 Codazzi–Mainardi 方程、Riemann 曲率张量、绝妙定理的第二个证明

items.title: The covariant derivative and Lie bracket; Riemann curvature tensor and Gauss's formulas revisited in index free notation
items.zh: 协变导数与 Lie 括号；用无指标记号重述 Riemann 曲率张量与 Gauss 公式

items.title: The induced Lie bracket on surfaces. Self adjointness of the shape operator, Riemann curvature tensor of surfaces, Gauss and Codazzi Mainardi equations, and Theorema Egregium revisited
items.zh: 曲面上的诱导 Lie 括号；形状算子的自伴性、曲面的 Riemann 曲率张量、Gauss 与 Codazzi–Mainardi 方程、绝妙定理再述

items.title: The definition of geodesic curvature, and the proof that it is intrinsic
items.zh: 测地曲率的定义及其内蕴性证明

items.title: The Gauss-Bonnet theorem and its applications
items.zh: Gauss–Bonnet 定理及其应用

items.title: Review of basics of Euclidean Geometry and Topology
items.zh: 欧氏几何与拓扑基础回顾

items.title: Definition of manifolds and some examples
items.zh: 流形的定义与例子

items.title: Immersions and Embeddings
items.zh: 浸入与嵌入

items.title: Definition of differential structures and smooth mappings between manifolds
items.zh: 微分结构的定义、流形间的光滑映射

items.title: Definition of Tangent space. Characterization of tangent space as derivations of the germs of functions
items.zh: 切空间的定义；把切空间刻画为函数芽的导子

items.title: Smooth submanifolds, and immersions. Proof of the smooth embeddibility of smooth manifolds in Euclidean space. Tangent Bundles.
items.zh: 光滑子流形与浸入；光滑流形到欧氏空间的光滑嵌入性证明；切丛

items.title: Definition of a Riemannian metric, and examples of Riemannian manifolds
items.zh: Riemann 度量的定义与 Riemann 流形的例子

items.title: Connections, covariant derivative, parallel translations, Foucault's pendulum, and geodesics
items.zh: 联络、协变导数、平行移动、Foucault 摆与测地线

items.title: Riemannian connections, brackets, proof of the fundamental theorem of Riemannian geometry, induced connection on Riemannian submanifolds, reparameterizations and speed of geodesics, geodesics of the Poincare's upper half plane
items.zh: Riemann 联络、括号、Riemann 几何基本定理的证明、Riemann 子流形上的诱导联络、测地线的重参数化与速率、Poincaré 上半平面的测地线

items.title: Exponential map and geodesic flow
items.zh: 指数映射与测地流

coverage.note: 讲义第二卷止于指数映射与测地流，一般流形上的 Riemann 曲率张量没有单独一讲；曲率主要在曲面的讲次（I.9–I.14）里建立，并已在 I.12/I.13 定义曲面的 Riemann 曲率张量。

omitted: 第二卷的 Lecture 6（反函数定理与秩定理）、8（Whitney 嵌入定理）、9–10（正则值、Sard 定理、带边流形、Brouwer 不动点）、11（可定向性）、13（流形上的积分与体积、单位分解）讲的是分析/拓扑工具，与节点简介的六个知识点无直接对应，未收。
notes: 选源说明：节点“现有英文学习资源” MIT OCW 18.950 的 lecture-notes 页（https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-950-differential-geometry-fall-2008/pages/lecture-notes/，我已打开）只按 4 章列出章标题（Local and global geometry of plane curves / Local geometry of hypersurfaces / Global geometry of hypersurfaces / Geometry of lengths and distances），既无逐讲题目也无小节，做不了细颗粒度导览图，故按优先级 2 换成 Georgia Tech 的同主题课程讲义（每讲都有具体主题）。编号说明：原页面分两卷、各自从 “Lecture Notes 1” 起编号，为避免两卷 ref 冲突，这里写作 I.1…I.16、II.1…II.16，表示第一卷/第二卷第几讲。
